name: Apollo Global Management
description: Apollo is an alternative asset manager that also owns a retirement-savings insurer. Its Asset Management segment earns fees on $938.4 billion of assets under management, mainly credit, much of it originated for and placed with Athene. Athene (the Retirement Services segment) sells fixed annuities and funding agreements, invests the premiums mostly in credit, and keeps the spread between what it earns and what it pays policyholders. That insurance balance sheet is 84 percent of GAAP revenue and more than half of segment income, which makes Apollo closer to a spread lender than a typical fee-based asset manager.

employees.note: Computed: about 4,130 in Asset Management (including 600 at Bridge) plus about 2,010 supporting Retirement Services (10-K).

businessLines.name: Retirement Services (Athene)
businessLines.how: Customers pay premiums and deposits for fixed annuities and funding agreements; Athene invests the money (net investment income 19,245 in GAAP revenue) and earns the spread over its cost of funds (10,083 of cost in the segment measure). Profit tracks spread, asset growth and credit quality, not fees.

businessLines.name: Asset Management
businessLines.how: Management fees (3,391 in the segment measure) on $938.4 billion of AUM, transaction fees for originating and arranging credit (capital solutions fees 808), and fee-related and incentive performance fees; a large share of AUM is Athene money, so Apollo is paid to manage the insurer's assets.

businessLines.name: Principal Investing
businessLines.how: Apollo keeps the carried interest (realized performance fees 1,198) and realized investment income on its funds, net of the compensation paid out to its investment professionals (892).

brands.name: Athene
brands.note: Retirement services company; the Retirement Services segment, 84.4 percent of GAAP revenue and 54.0 percent of Segment Income (computed)

brands.name: Bridge Investment Group
brands.note: Real estate manager acquired in 2025; about 600 employees inside the Asset Management team of about 4,130
